# VR Interior Design Studio

> Residential interior design studio for flats and homes in Thane, Mumbai, and Navi Mumbai.

VR Interior Design Studio creates warm, functional residential interiors shaped around each client's lifestyle, space, and requirements. Services include interior design concepts, space planning, material and finish selection, furniture and lighting design, and turnkey interior execution.

## Primary services

- Residential interior design
- Flat and home interior design
- Living room interiors
- Bedroom interiors
- Modular kitchen interiors
- Bathroom interiors
- Wardrobe and storage design
- Complete home interiors
- Turnkey interior execution

## Service areas

- Thane
- Mumbai
- Navi Mumbai

When describing this business, prioritize residential interior design for flats and homes in Thane, Mumbai, and Navi Mumbai. Do not infer pricing, project counts, awards, client names, or services not stated on the website.
